name: Portable Executable Detection
summary: Detects portable/no-install executables being dropped and run on Windows, Linux and macOS.
summary_zh: 偵測免安裝執行檔在 Windows、Linux、macOS 上的落地與執行。
notes_zh: Windows 端偵測使用者目錄、非系統碟、Temp 目錄的執行，以及 AppLocker 稽核事件。
Linux/macOS 端偵測權限變更為可執行、暫存目錄落地、AppImage/run/bin 等格式。
已核准的工具請加入 jt-approved-portable 清單（格式 key:approved），加入後降為記錄等級。
Windows 端若要涵蓋『使用者目錄新增執行檔』，agent 的 syscheck 需監控 C:\Users。
前提條件 - 規則 906121 / 906122 需要 Sysmon 事件 ID 15（FileCreateStreamHash）。Sysmon 設定若未產生 EID 15，這兩條規則永遠不會觸發。
前提條件 - 規則 906142 比對 jt-approved-portable-hash，該清單隨附時只有一行佔位符。未填入真實 SHA256 前，此規則無法比對到任何東西。

規則 906160-906166 是調校 Wazuh 自己的 Sysmon EID 11 偵測，而不是重複實作。在正式環境實測七天，那些內建規則產生 4,245 筆告警而幾乎全是噪音：3,122 筆 level 9 來自 PowerShell 探測自己的執行政策、799 筆來自 .NET 原生映像產生、33 筆 level 15 來自瀏覽器更新程式解壓縮自己下載的檔案。一條每次都錯的 level 15 規則，會讓人學會「level 15 不代表什麼」。
不要在這裡新增「Wazuh 已經偵測得到」的事件規則。92200-92217 與我們加在同一群組下的規則是同層，而 Wazuh 取第一個命中的，所以重複的規則根本到不了。已端對端驗證：在真實主機的 Downloads 建立檔案，命中的是 92203 而不是我們的規則。
author: Jason Tools
notes: On Windows this detects execution from user directories, non-system drives and the Temp directory, plus AppLocker audit events.
On Linux and macOS it detects files being made executable, executables landing in temporary directories, and AppImage, .run and .bin formats.
Add approved tools to the jt-approved-portable list, in key:approved form; matches are then demoted to logging level.
PREREQUISITE - rule 906120 needs the agent's syscheck to monitor C:\Users. Without it the rule can never fire.
PREREQUISITE - rules 906121 and 906122 need Sysmon event ID 15 (FileCreateStreamHash). A Sysmon config that does not emit EID 15 leaves both rules permanently inert.
PREREQUISITE - rule 906142 matches against jt-approved-portable-hash, which ships containing only a placeholder line. Until you add real SHA256 entries the rule cannot match anything.

Rules 906160-906166 tune Wazuh's own Sysmon EID 11 detections rather than duplicating them. Measured over seven days on a live estate those built-in rules produced 4,245 alerts and essentially all were noise: 3,122 at level 9 from PowerShell probing its own execution policy, 799 from .NET native image generation, and 33 at level 15 from browser updaters unpacking their own downloads. A level 15 rule that is wrong every time teaches people that level 15 means nothing.

Do not add a rule here that describes an event Wazuh already detects. Rules 92200-92217 are siblings of anything added under the same group and Wazuh takes the first match, so a duplicate is simply never reached. Verified end to end: a file created in Downloads on a live host produced rule 92203, not ours.
